evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Clear, bounded CRUD-style functionality with specified inputs; can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Specific mechanism (URL) and outcome (access game) are clear enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Well-scoped UI behavior and data entry; implementation effort can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: A session list view is a standard, bounded feature; not overly broad.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single interaction with clear effect (team sees selected item); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Simple add-to-list behavior; scope is clear and bounded.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Standard edit functionality on an existing entity; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Standard delete operation with clear target; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Specific behavior toggle/command with clear condition; can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Defined computation (average) and action (accept); bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Clear trigger condition and outcome; straightforward to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Simple data entry for an estimate value; bounded scope.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation within session is a clear extension of round mechanics; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Underspecified breadth (file formats, mapping columns, validation, duplicates, error handling) makes effort hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: More constrained than full import: implies paste text into UI and parse; reasonably estimatable despite minor parsing details.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games ... find the previous game I'm looking for
evaluations.rationale: Browsing could range from simple paginated list to search/filter/sort and metadata; scope is broad enough to hinder estimation.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game ... see the stories and estimates
evaluations.rationale: Clear output (stories and estimates) for a selected game; bounded display feature.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Specific export format and content (transcript) are defined enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Specific export format and content; estimatable even if exact columns are later refined.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Clear delete behavior and scope (game plus associated data); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Specified fields and action; standard registration feature is estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Standard authentication flow; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Too broad: unclear which details, what constraints/verification (email change, password change, username change), and required flows; hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Clear deletion scope (account info and games); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Single cross-cutting but well-defined behavior (timezone conversion/display); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Common, bounded password reset/reminder capability; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Clearly enumerated options and purpose; bounded configuration feature.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Concrete limit and action; straightforward to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Clear join flow with specified input; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Simple display requirement with clear content; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: List view of session items; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Specific UI feedback requirement; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear condition and behavior; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Defined time window and action; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Specific data to display (prior estimates per estimator for current story); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Clear display of mapping estimator→estimate for current round; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Concrete duration and shared visibility; bounded feature.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear trigger and action; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Specific navigation behavior over known data (prior rounds); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Clear consistency requirement for ordering; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Defined condition (draw not completed) and action; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Specific UI element and placement intent; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Compliance scope is broad and potentially system-wide; without specifying target standard versions/coverage, effort is hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Bounded deliverable (glossary/list); can be estimated even if exact terms evolve.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible
evaluations.rationale: Open-ended optimization goal (“as fast as possible”) and unclear scope (which queries/tables, performance targets) makes estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: System-wide compatibility across multiple legacy browsers is broad and can vary greatly depending on current state; difficult to estimate from this statement alone.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: “Where possible” makes scope ambiguous; accessibility compliance can range from minor fixes to major redesign, hindering estimation.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Non-specific performance requirement without measurable targets or scope (which actions, response times, load) is too vague to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode ... use any language I like
evaluations.rationale: Potentially system-wide internationalization/input/storage/rendering implications are broad and underspecified; hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: “Sensible and predictable” is subjective and could imply broad routing/IA changes; insufficiently specified for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: “Nice” and “when something goes wrong” are vague and potentially cover many error scenarios; difficult to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Anonymization/non-identifiability is complex and underspecified (what identifiers, threat model, aggregation rules), making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: “Some metrics” is undefined (which metrics, time ranges, dashboards, privacy); scope is too open-ended to estimate.
